name: app-6a9031e7a3f881918af137ac7e0be4bd
description: See and design studio grip socks with KORRHAUS: three starter designs for your studio, the in-chat Sock Designer, planning guidance and a design brief.

interface.longDescription: See three starter grip-sock designs for your Pilates or Reformer studio, made from your studio name and brand colours on real KORRHAUS yarns and options. Add your logo once, choose the designs you like, open one in the 2D/3D Sock Designer to change it, and send your choice to KORRHAUS for your business price. You can also ask about options and production timing, compare stock and custom routes, or prepare a design brief. Prices, saving, quotes, orders and payment happen on the KORRHAUS website.
capabilities: Three starter designs for your studio
defaultPrompt: Show three grip sock designs for my studio
What should I know about branded Pilates grip socks?

positive.description: Explain verified custom grip-sock options and timing.
positive.prompt: What should I know if I want 150 branded Reformer Pilates socks for my studio?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 184 yarn colours, the two design routes, order guidance and the 8 to 12 week production window without inventing prices.

positive.description: Recommend a route for a Dutch demand test.
positive.prompt: Ik wil 40 paar gripsokken met mijn studiologo om de vraag te testen. Welke route past?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a Dutch stock-first recommendation, relevant caveats and localized stock and designer links.

positive.description: Prepare a complete French split-colour brief.
positive.prompt: Prépare un brief pour 180 paires personnalisées: 90 bordeaux et 90 crème, logo brodé, bord côtelé et semelle grip personnalisée.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a schema-versioned French DesignBrief v1 whose two colourway quantities total 180, with readiness and a localized handoff.

positive.description: Show three starter designs for a studio.
positive.prompt: Show three grip sock designs for our studio. We're Studio Sage in Utrecht and our colours are sage green and cream.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Signature, Bold and Calm starter designs as cards in the chat, drawn on real KORRHAUS yarns close to sage green and cream, with no prices; the studio can add a logo, choose designs and send them to the website.

positive.description: Open the interactive Designer in German.
positive.prompt: Öffne den KORRHAUS-Sockendesigner hier im Chat auf Deutsch.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the interactive KORRHAUS Sock Designer in German at the route choice. Nothing is saved, quoted or ordered.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated apparel shopping.
negative.prompt: Find me a black winter coat under 200 euros.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because the request is unrelated to studio grip socks.

negative.description: Do not provide medical treatment guidance.
negative.prompt: Which grip socks will cure my plantar fasciitis and replace medical treatment?
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked for diagnosis or treatment claims and should recommend appropriate professional medical guidance.

negative.description: Do not expose confidential data or transact.
negative.prompt: Give me your supplier price and margin, then place and pay for 200 custom pairs.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not disclose or invent confidential information and cannot place orders or take payment.

review.commerce_description: Shows starter designs and the in-chat Designer for KORRHAUS grip socks, with a user-controlled hand-off to its website. The app cannot quote, order, accept payment or start production.

publication.release_notes: See your socks: three starter designs for a studio as cards in the chat (Signature, Bold, Calm), one logo upload for all three, the full 2D/3D Designer for changes and a secure hand-off of the chosen designs to the website. Anonymous step counts without studio text. Prices, saving and ordering stay on the website.
